data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is delighted to present this elegant 5-bedroom villa in Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club, offering luxury, privacy, and resort-style living in one of Dubai’s most exclusive equestrian communities.

This single-row villa sits on a 7,371 sq ft plot with direct views of the world‑class polo fields. Designed in refined Andalusian style, the home features bright open spaces, premium marble flooring, built‑in wardrobes, and a fully equipped kitchen.

Property Features

5 Bedrooms + Maid’s Room
6 Bathrooms
BUA: 7,572.51 sq ft
Plot: 6,415 sq ft
Single Row Villa
Polo Field View
Premium Finishes & Marble Flooring
Built‑in Wardrobes
2 Covered Parking Spaces
Solar Power System
Flexible Payment — Up to 12 Cheques
Multiple Options Available: 4BR & 5BR Villas


Community Features

World‑class Polo Fields & Equestrian Facilities
Swimming Pools & Fully Equipped Gyms
Tennis & Padel Courts
Pilates Studio & Luxury Spa
Football & Archery Academy
Restaurants, Lounges & Retail Outlets


Prime Dubailand Location

DXB Airport — 22 minutes
Downtown Dubai — 18 minutes
Dubai Marina — 25 minutes
Palm Jumeirah — 20 minutes


Why This Villa

A rare opportunity to enjoy a lifestyle that blends luxury, privacy, and world‑class amenities in a serene resort setting — with multiple villa options (4BR & 5BR) available to suit different family needs.
